race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
race.verdict: ARTHUR CARROT had a bit more in hand than the final margin indicates when accounting for stablemate Bacha at Lingfield the previous week, so a 6 lb higher mark looks well within his compass, especially as it's doubtful we've seen the best of him yet. Odegaard has shaped well on both his nursery outings and is one to take seriously, while last-time-out winner Thai Baht should have the race run to suit again on her first try at 7f. ARTHUR CARROT ODEGAARD THAI BAHT
